title: Americas & Polynesia (Maya, Aztec, Inca, North America, Hawaii, Aotearoa & Tonga — Pending Bridge)

nodes.name: Tepeu, Gucumatz (Feathered Serpent) & Huracán (Heart of Sky)
nodes.notes: Creator assembly in Popol Vuh shaping earth, animals, wooden men destroyed by a great flood of resin, and finally humanity from white and yellow maize.

nodes.name: Xpiyacoc & Xmucane → Hun Hunahpu (+ Xquic) → Hero Twins (Hunahpu & Xbalanque)
nodes.notes: First diviners Xpiyacoc & Xmucane father Hun Hunahpu, whose Hero Twins Hunahpu and Xbalanque descend to Xibalba and rise as Sun and Moon.

nodes.name: Four Maize Ancestors: Balam-Quitzé, Balam-Acab, Mahucutah & Iqui-Balam
nodes.era: Early K'iche' & Classical Maya Ancestral Horizon
nodes.role: Four Founding Patriarchs of Maya Royal Lineages
nodes.notes: The four first humans fashioned from yellow and white corn alongside their four wives (Cahá-Paluma, Chomihá, Tzununihá, Caquixahá), progenitors of the K'iche' & Maya lineages.

nodes.name: Ometeotl → Quetzalcoatl, Tezcatlipoca, Xipe Totec & Huitzilopochtli
nodes.notes: Ometeotl (Ometecuhtli & Omecihuatl) births the four cosmic directions: Quetzalcoatl (Feathered Serpent), Tezcatlipoca, Xipe Totec, and Huitzilopochtli.

nodes.name: Tata & Nene (Fourth Sun Flood) → Quetzalcoatl Recreates Fifth Sun Humanity
nodes.era: Legend of the Five Suns (Codex Chimalpopoca)
nodes.notes: In the Fourth Sun (Chalchiuhtlicue), Tata and Nene are warned to hollow out a giant ahuehuete cypress trunk to survive the Deluge; Quetzalcoatl later descends to Mictlan for sacred bones.

nodes.name: Aztlán / Chicomoztoc → Acamapichtli → Moctezuma I → Moctezuma II
nodes.notes: Seven tribes emerge from Chicomoztoc ('Seven Caves'); Mexica settle Lake Texcoco (Tenochtitlan) under Huitzilopochtli's eagle sign, elevating Acamapichtli as 1st Tlatoani.

nodes.name: Viracocha (Uno Pachacuti Flood) → Inti (Sun) & Mama Quilla (Moon)
nodes.role: Creator Deity of Tiwanaku & Great Flood
sources: Garcilaso de la Vega Royal Commentaries
nodes.notes: Viracocha wipes away the first giants with Uno Pachacuti (Great Flood) before carving nations out of stone at Tiwanaku and birthing Inti and Mama Quilla.

nodes.name: Manco Cápac & Mama Ocllo (Four Ayar Brothers → Founders of Cusco)
sources: Garcilaso de la Vega Royal Commentaries
nodes.notes: Sibling-spouses sent from Lake Titicaca with a golden rod to sink into fertile Cusco earth, establishing the Hanan and Hurin Inca dynasty.

nodes.name: Sinchi Roca → Pachacuti (Machu Picchu) → Tupac Inca → Huayna Capac → Atahualpa
nodes.notes: From Sinchi Roca through empire-builder Pachacuti, conqueror Tupac Inca Yupanqui, Huayna Capac, and civil-war brothers Huascar and Atahualpa.

nodes.name: Sky Woman (Atahensic) → Twin Brothers → Hiawatha & The Great Peacemaker
nodes.role: Turtle Island Creation & Haudenosaunee Confederacy Founders
nodes.notes: Sky Woman descends onto Turtle Island; grandsons Sapling (Tharonhiawakon) and Flint shape humanity, leading historically to Deganawida and Hiawatha uniting the Five Nations.

nodes.name: First Man & First Woman / Changing Woman (Diné) & White Buffalo Calf Woman (Lakota)
nodes.notes: Changing Woman (Asdzą́ą́ Nádleehé) creates the four original Diné clans; White Buffalo Calf Woman brings the Sacred Pipe (Chanunpa) to the Oceti Sakowin (Seven Council Fires).

nodes.name: Te Kore / Te Pō → Ranginui (Sky Father) & Papatūānuku (Earth Mother)
nodes.notes: Locked in eternal embrace within Te Pō until their children separate Heaven and Earth so light (Te Ao Mārama) enters the world.

nodes.name: Tāne-mahuta (+ Hine-ahu-one from Clay!), Tangaroa & Tūmatauenga
nodes.role: Creator of First Mortal Woman from Red Earth & Lords of Sea/War
nodes.notes: Tāne separates Rangi & Papa and fashions Hine-ahu-one (the Earth-formed Maid) from red clay at Kurawaka, breathing mauri (life) into her nostrils to begin human whakapapa.

nodes.name: Māui (Māui-tikitiki-a-Taranga — Pan-Polynesian Hero)
nodes.role: Trickster Hero Who Fished Up Islands & Snared the Sun
nodes.notes: Culture hero across Aotearoa, Hawai'i, Tonga & Samoa who slowed the Sun, stole fire from Mahuika, and hauled up Te Ika-a-Māui (North Island).

nodes.name: Wākea & Papahānaumoku → Hoʻohōkūkalani → Hāloa → King Kamehameha I
nodes.notes: Over 2,000 chant lines tracing Wākea (Sky) and Papa (Earth) to Hāloa (taro ancestor and first Hawaiian chief) down to unifier King Kamehameha I.

nodes.name: Hawaiki → Kupe (Aotearoa), ʻAhoʻeitu (Tuʻi Tonga) & Hotu Matuʻa (Rapa Nui)
nodes.role: Great Double-Hulled Waka Explorers & Island Dynasty Founders
nodes.notes: Kupe navigates Matahourua to Aotearoa; ʻAhoʻeitu inaugurates the 39-king Tuʻi Tonga dynasty; Hotu Matuʻa settles Rapa Nui (Easter Island).
